title: Preview artifacts
description: `aidd-evidence/preview/<head_sha>/artifacts.json`: what the verifier recorded while it ran the preview of that head (`[preview]`): screenshots, a trace or video, an API transcript, each beside this file. For people only: the gate decides on the evidence's exit codes and never reads these; the Merge approval page shows them.

path.description: The file, relative to the evidence folder, such as `preview/<head_sha>/a1-checkout.png`.

kind.description: screenshot: one state of the UI; trace or video: the main flow, step by step; transcript: the requests and responses of an API.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256, so a reader can tell it is the file the verifier recorded.
